To produce 2D and 3D drawings/designs for the manufacturing and assembly processes in accordance with customer requirements/specifications, whilst ensuring full compliance to applicable Fives policies/procedures and regulatory and international standards
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant Engineering field
Minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience
Knowledge of AutoCAD software is a must
Knowledge of Solidworks software is a must
Knowledge of MS Office is advantageous.

By becoming part of Fives, you will join an international group offering access to a wide range of growth and mobility opportunities. We provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and develop both professionally and personally.
